title: Add malicious user to Admins and RDP users group via PowerShell
description: Look for adding a user to Administrators in remote desktop users via PowerShell.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Parent Process Name' = 'powershell.exe') and (('Command Line' like '*$admins=*' and 'Command Line' like '*System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier*' and 'Command Line' like '*Translate*' and 'Command Line' like '*-split*' and 'Command Line' like '*localgroup*' and 'Command Line' like '*/add*' and 'Command Line' like '*$rdp=*'))
